<script>
/**
 * DataLayer Listener - Swiggy AJAX AddToCart
 * Resolves missing add_to_cart / add_to_cart_stape events caused by swiggy-cart plugin.
 */
(function() {
  if (window._swiggyAddToCartListenerAttached) return;
  window._swiggyAddToCartListenerAttached = true;

  function pushAddToCartEvent(productId, qty) {
    qty = parseInt(qty, 10) || 1;
    productId = String(productId || '').trim();
    if (!productId) return;

    var itemName = '';
    var price = 0;
    var category = '';
    var currency = 'INR';

    // 1. Check dataLayer for matching item from view_item_stape
    var dl = window.dataLayer || [];
    for (var i = dl.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      var entry = dl[i];
      if (entry && entry.ecommerce) {
        if (entry.ecommerce.currency) {
          currency = entry.ecommerce.currency;
        }
        var items = entry.ecommerce.items;
        if (items && items.length) {
          for (var j = 0; j < items.length; j++) {
            var it = items[j];
            if (String(it.item_id || it.id) === productId) {
              itemName = it.item_name || it.name || '';
              price = parseFloat(it.price || it.item_price || 0) || 0;
              category = it.item_category || it.category || '';
              break;
            }
          }
        }
      }
      if (itemName) break;
    }

    // 2. Fallback: inspect product card in DOM for loop/catalog pages
    if (!itemName) {
      var swiggyContainer = document.querySelector('.swiggy-cart[data-product_id="' + productId + '"]');
      var productCard = swiggyContainer ? swiggyContainer.closest('.product, .product-item, .wc-block-grid__product') : null;
      if (productCard) {
        var titleEl = productCard.querySelector('.product_title, .woocommerce-loop-product__title, .name a, h2, h3');
        if (titleEl) {
          itemName = titleEl.innerText.trim();
        }
        var priceEl = productCard.querySelector('.price ins .amount, .price .amount, .woocommerce-Price-amount');
        if (priceEl) {
          var cleanPrice = priceEl.innerText.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '');
          price = parseFloat(cleanPrice) || 0;
        }
      }
    }

    // 3. Fallback for single product page
    if (!itemName && document.querySelector('body.single-product')) {
      var singleTitle = document.querySelector('h1.product_title, .entry-title');
      if (singleTitle) {
        itemName = singleTitle.innerText.trim();
      }
      var singlePrice = document.querySelector('.price ins .amount, .price .amount, .woocommerce-Price-amount');
      if (singlePrice) {
        var cleanSinglePrice = singlePrice.innerText.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '');
        price = parseFloat(cleanSinglePrice) || 0;
      }
    }

    var totalValue = parseFloat((price * qty).toFixed(2));

    window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
    window.dataLayer.push({ ecommerce: null });
    window.dataLayer.push({
      event: 'add_to_cart_stape',
      ecommerce: {
        currency: currency,
        value: String(totalValue),
        items: [
          {
            item_id: productId,
            item_name: itemName,
            price: String(price),
            quantity: qty,
            item_category: category
          }
        ]
      }
    });

    if (window.jQuery) {
      window.jQuery(document.body).trigger('added_to_cart');
    }
  }

  function attachListener() {
    if (window.jQuery) {
      window.jQuery(document).on('ajaxSuccess', function(event, xhr, settings) {
        try {
          if (!settings || !settings.url) return;
          if (settings.url.indexOf('wc-ajax=add_to_cart') === -1) return;
          if (xhr.responseJSON && xhr.responseJSON.error === true) return;

          var data = settings.data;
          var productId = '';
          var qty = 1;

          if (typeof data === 'string') {
            var params = new URLSearchParams(data);
            productId = params.get('product_id');
            qty = params.get('quantity') || 1;
          } else if (data && typeof data === 'object') {
            productId = data.product_id;
            qty = data.quantity || 1;
          }

          if (productId) {
            pushAddToCartEvent(productId, qty);
          }
        } catch (e) {
          console.error('[GTM DataLayer Listener] Error:', e);
        }
      });
    } else {
      setTimeout(attachListener, 200);
    }
  }

  attachListener();
})();
</script>
